rules.pace: 2 new pins/day at 13:00Z and 20:00Z (on top of the Oct 19 batch: 15:00/16:00Z daily to Nov 9, holiday 00:00Z Nov 2-14). Keep ~7 days of new pins scheduled ahead; never more than 4 pins on one day.
rules.ownWorkOnly: Pin only our own images: album covers (assets/covers/albums/uniform-v3), our color cards / mood boards / graphics, or grids of our covers. Never a brand product photo on its own.
rules.links: Every link must be a real mahjmatchmaker.com page (or shopmy.us/mahjmatchmaker for Amazon-board pins) that curls 200.
rules.copy: Keyword-first titles <=100 chars (mahjong tiles / mahjong mat / <set> / colour words / mahjong table decor); no coupon/promo wording; Amazon-board pins never name brand mats (no Rackin' Rudolph, Polo Club, Rattan).
rules.holiday: Holiday/Christmas pins not before Nov 1 (notBefore). Paige Spearin x TdT never promoted. No Mahjong Studios mats.
